name: search_products
description: Find products to buy. Searches sellable variants by words, brand, category, purpose, skin type, ingredient, stock and price (SGD cents). Returns variant_id, price and stock for each match; follow next_page for more.

q.description: Search words, e.g. "cerave cleanser" or "gift for dad under $40". A price phrase sets max_price when it is absent.

category.description: Category name or slug, e.g. "pantry" or "skincare".

max_price.description: Highest price in SGD cents (S$40 is 4000).

page.description: Result page; use next_page from the previous result.

name: get_product
description: Read one product in full: description, ingredients, usage, images, every variant with price and stock, delivery estimate and return policy. product accepts a product ID, product slug, variant slug or SKU.

product.description: A product ID, product slug, variant slug or SKU, e.g. from search_products.

name: create_cart
description: Start shopping: creates a cart, no account needed. Pass items [{variant_id, quantity}] to start it with the whole basket in one call. Returns cart_id, version and, for guests, a private guest_token: pass guest_token on every later call and never share it. Next: quote_cart.

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

items.description: Optional: start the cart with these items (up to 20 variants), instead of calling set_cart_item for each. A variant listed twice is added together.

name: get_cart
description: Read a cart's items, codes, current version and whether a checkout has locked it. Use quote_cart for prices and totals.

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

name: set_cart_item
description: Add, change or remove one item in an existing cart. quantity is the total wanted (not an increment); 0 removes it. Send the cart's current version; the result has the new one. If the version is stale, the error includes current_cart. Up to 20 variants and 99 of each; stock is checked.

version.description: The cart's current version, from the last cart result. Each edit increments it.

quantity.description: The total quantity wanted (not an increment); 0 removes the item.

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

name: set_cart_coupon
description: Older way to apply a code: saves a coupon or a friend's referral code to the cart (null removes both). Send the current version. Prefer coupon_code on quote_cart and create_checkout. Automatic discounts apply either way.

version.description: The cart's current version, from the last cart result. Each edit increments it.

coupon_code.description: A coupon code or a friend's referral code; null removes both.

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

name: quote_cart
description: Price the cart now: current prices, discounts, stock, free Singapore delivery and the total, all in SGD cents. Stock is not reserved. coupon_code previews a coupon or a friend's referral code without saving it. With account_token, applies the customer's cashback credit unless use_credit is false. Next: create_checkout with this version and total.

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

coupon_code.description: A coupon code or a friend's referral code to apply; null removes both. quote_cart previews it; create_checkout applies it.

account_token.description: Private account token from sign_in, after the customer gave you the code from their email. Lets quotes and checkout use their cashback credit, and opens their orders.

use_credit.description: Use the signed-in customer's cashback credit (default true).

name: create_checkout
description: Lock the quoted cart for purchase. Send the quote's version, its total as expected_total and a new idempotency_key; coupon_code applies a code. Pass details (the buyer's contact and Singapore delivery details) to save them here instead of calling set_checkout_details. Returns checkout_id, details_version and a review link. Does not charge anything. Next: show the buyer the details and total, then prepare_payment.

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

account_token.description: Private account token from sign_in, after the customer gave you the code from their email. Lets quotes and checkout use their cashback credit, and opens their orders.

use_credit.description: Use the signed-in customer's cashback credit (default true).

coupon_code.description: A coupon code or a friend's referral code to apply; null removes both. quote_cart previews it; create_checkout applies it.

version.description: The version from the quote_cart result you are checking out.

expected_total.description: The total from that quote, in SGD cents. Checkout refuses if the total changed.

idempotency_key.description: A new random key per purchase. Retry with the same key and exact input; never reuse it for a different purchase.

unit_number.description: e.g. #12-34. Required unless no_unit_number is true.

no_unit_number.description: true for a landed house or other address with no unit number.

details.description: Optional: the buyer's contact and Singapore delivery details, saved with the checkout (details_version 1) instead of a separate set_checkout_details call. The buyer still confirms them and the total before prepare_payment.

name: get_checkout
description: Read a checkout: saved contact and delivery details, details_version, total, status and the ways to finish (review link, payment link). These details and links are private to the buyer.

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

name: set_checkout_details
description: Save the buyer's contact and Singapore delivery details on a checkout. Send its current details_version; the result has the new one. Does not charge anything. Details can't change once payment preparation starts.

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

details_version.description: The checkout's current details_version from get_checkout (0 before any details are saved).

unit_number.description: e.g. #12-34. Required unless no_unit_number is true.

no_unit_number.description: true for a landed house or other address with no unit number.

details.description: Contact and Singapore delivery details exactly as the buyer gave them.

name: prepare_payment
description: Get the hosted Stripe payment link, only after the buyer confirmed the saved details and total: send buyer_confirmed=true, that details_version, that total and an idempotency_key (reuse it on retries). Creates an unpaid order; nothing is charged until the buyer, or an agent they explicitly authorized, pays on Stripe. Then poll get_order.

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

expected_total.description: The total the buyer confirmed, in SGD cents.

idempotency_key.description: A new random key per purchase. Retry with the same key and exact input; never reuse it for a different purchase.

buyer_confirmed.description: true only after the buyer confirmed these details and this total.

name: get_order
description: Check an order: payment and delivery status, items, tracking and any cancellation or return request. Works for orders this session or account connection placed (guest_token for guests) and, with account_token, any of the signed-in customer's orders. Once paid it includes referral.message: show it to the customer exactly as written. Read-only; to cancel or return, use request_order_change.

order_id.description: order_id from prepare_payment, get_checkout or list_orders, e.g. TN-…

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

account_token.description: Private account token from sign_in, after the customer gave you the code from their email. Lets quotes and checkout use their cashback credit, and opens their orders.

name: checkout_session
description: Shortcut from product feed items to a checkout: send feed item ids (tanatasa-variant-<id>) and quantities. Guests call create_cart first and pass its guest_token. Item names and prices you send are ignored; Tanatasa's catalogue is authoritative. Returns a checkout and review link; continue with set_checkout_details and prepare_payment.

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

id.description: The product feed item id, tanatasa-variant-<variant_id>.

checkout_session.description: The items to buy: up to 20 feed items with quantities.

idempotency_key.description: A new random key per purchase; retry with the same key.

name: sign_in
description: Sign the customer in with a code from their email. 1) Send email: Tanatasa emails them a 6-digit code. 2) Send email and the code they read to you: returns a private account_token (24 hours, this session only). 3) Send only account_token: shows their referral code and cashback credit with expiry dates. The token lets quote_cart and create_checkout use their credit and list_orders and get_order open their orders. Never guess a code.

email.description: The customer's email. Alone: Tanatasa emails them a 6-digit code. With code: signs them in.

code.description: The 6-digit code the customer read from their email.

account_token.description: Private account token from sign_in, after the customer gave you the code from their email. Lets quotes and checkout use their cashback credit, and opens their orders.

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

name: list_orders
description: List the signed-in customer's paid orders, newest first, from the website or any assistant: status, total, items, tracking and change requests. Needs account_token from sign_in (or an account-linked connection). Follow next_page for older orders.

account_token.description: Private account token from sign_in, after the customer gave you the code from their email. Lets quotes and checkout use their cashback credit, and opens their orders.

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

page.description: Page; use next_page from the previous result.

name: request_order_change
description: Ask Tanatasa to cancel a paid order that hasn't shipped (kind cancel) or to take back a shipped or delivered order (kind return), with the customer's reason. Staff review it and email the customer; nothing is refunded or changed until then. Repeating the call returns the open request. Unpaid orders need no cancellation: they are never charged.

order_id.description: order_id from prepare_payment, get_checkout or list_orders, e.g. TN-…

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

account_token.description: Private account token from sign_in, after the customer gave you the code from their email. Lets quotes and checkout use their cashback credit, and opens their orders.

kind.description: cancel: a paid order that hasn't shipped. return: a shipped or delivered order.

reason.description: The customer's reason, in their words.

items.description: For a return of only some items: variant_id and quantity from get_order. Omit for the whole order.
